reviewNotes: Imported from CCEH tune 000149 (the melody read from 000149a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, 2 notes off in 20); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. George William Warren's dates (1828–1902) are from https://etudemagazine.com/etude/1902/05/mixtures-7.html (The Etude, May 1902: died 9 March 1902); https://snaccooperative.org/vocab_administrator/resources/6352734; CCEH's page gives only the year 1876. The bar lines are those of CCEH's Noteworthy score (000149a.nwc).
